items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Johnny St. Cyris already does that too... INTERVIEWEE: Well you see, yeah he played the guitar banjo... I remember when he left here with Louis Armstrong in there.

ctx.x: No, he's... He could pick and rap at the same time. Yeah. Combination. Yeah, combination. I don't know, he hit the up stroke and the bottom stroke. I don't know how he done it but I used to see him do like this, you know.
Johnny St. Cyris already does that too. He has a six string banjo.

Well you see, yeah he played the guitar banjo. He never played a tenor banjo. He played the guitar banjo, the six string banjo. He still does. He still play that. Yeah. I remember when he left here with Louis Armstrong in there. Yeah, went to Chicago, that's right.
